messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for Solaris (enterprise tenant) in eu-west-1. p99=1200ms, SLO p99=500ms. Affected: dedicated-pool-solaris-eu-west. Paging @oncall-sre. dashboard: https://rwd.infra/ops/alerts/1735000000
oncall-sre: I'm on it — checking pool health and routing. Kai, any serving-side signals?
kai-engineer: seeing p95 ~600ms, p99 1.2s. GPU util ~95% on several nodes. KV cache miss rate jumped ~x3 at 02:12 UTC. Correlating with traffic burst from Solaris tenant.
nashok-sre: net metrics show ~5% packet loss to customer's VPC over transit A starting at 02:11 UTC. Opening ticket with netops.
oncall-sre: If the tenant is noisy, we should isolate it to warm spare nodes. Ashok, can you run tenant-shift to warm-pool?
kai-engineer: executing tenant shift now:
```
./ops/evict_tenant.sh --tenant=solaris --target=warm-pool-eu-west --drain=true
```
devops-bot: evict job queued: job-id=87bf12. estimated completion ~90s.
tom-solaris-cse: Solaris support here — customer reports increased latency and occasional 504s. They want ETA and confirmation no data lost.
sylvia-accounts: I'll send a short customer-facing update once we have an ETA. Tom, can you confirm percent impacted?
tom-solaris-cse: ~28% of requests > 1s, errors ~2% 504s. No signs of dropped data.
devops-bot: job 87bf12 started: draining 12 instances.
devops-bot: job 87bf12 completed at 1735000075. traffic shift in place: 8 warm nodes now handling Solaris.
kai-engineer: after shift p99 down to ~520ms, still above SLO but trending down. KV cache miss spike subsiding as warm nodes warm cache.
nashok-sre: netops confirms ISP route reroute cleared transit flap at 1735000080 — packet loss back to 0%.
oncall-sre: marking as mitigated for customer impact. I'll monitor for 30m. Assigning incident owner to kai-engineer for postmortem and follow-up. Handoff to day oncall (ashok-sre) in ~25m. severity: sev2.
sylvia-accounts: Customer update sent: "We applied mitigations and performance is recovering. Monitoring continues. Postmortem and timeline to follow." :thumbsup:
tom-solaris-cse: Customer acknowledges, requests postmortem and timeline.
kai-engineer: collecting logs, KV cache dumps, and autoscaler traces. I'll file the incident ticket and post link.
incidents-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-1735 by kai-engineer — https://rwd.infra/incidents/INC-2024-1735
ashok-sre: adding note: recommend follow-up action: add guardrails to tenant-evict automation to pre-warm warm-pool and tune autoscaler thresholds for dedicated pools.
kai-engineer: agreed. I'll include remediation and SLA impact calc in the postmortem.
sylvia-accounts: I will schedule a customer debrief once PM has the postmortem.
incidents-bot: incident state updated: mitigated -> monitoring. owner=kai-engineer.
_notes: thread created during overnight hours; short, focused coordination with clear mitigation: tenant isolation to warm pool + ISP reroute.
